apps.subtitle: Random clips from your group chats.
apps.localizedDescription:
Throwback plays a random photo or video from your Snapchat group chats with one tap, so everyone in the room can laugh at old clips together.

• Import your Snapchat "My Data" export (Chat Media + JSON) and pick which chats to use
• Modes: Everything, Hall of Fame, On this day, Time machine (one year)
• Shuffle like a deck of cards: every clip once before any repeats
• Guess who sent it: multiple choice with a running score
• Auto-play for parties, AirPlay to the TV, share a clip back to the chat
• Hide clips you never want to see again; stats on who sends the most

Everything stays on your phone. No servers, no accounts. Not affiliated with Snap Inc.
